name: Dashel Stonefist
summary: In Old Town, Dashel Stonefist draws notice for his quick temper, heavy hands, and dangerous connections. The dwarf called Fist keeps to Stormwind City's rougher alleys, where covert investigators are watching.

sections.title: A Brawler in Old Town
sections.body: Old Town knows Dashel Stonefist as Fist, a name earned in street fights. Locals and city guards see a drunken, combative dwarf, quick to throw a punch outside a tavern. His place in the district brings him close to Stormwind's underworld. Smugglers, cutpurses, and political agitators trade coin and rumors there, beyond the eyes of Cathedral Square.

sections.title: The Diplomat's Disappearance
sections.body: A missing diplomat brings covert royal investigators to Dashel Stonefist. Whispers of treachery point to the dwarf, a street-level contact for the Defias Brotherhood inside Stormwind's walls. He knows about the abduction, but refuses to speak until investigators beat him into submission. What he reveals reaches deeper into the kingdom's politics than a simple kidnapping.

faq.answer: In Stormwind City's Old Town, Dashel Stonefist works as a cutthroat and informant in the capital's shadowy quarters. The dwarf called Fist has a violent reputation and a habit of brawling.

faq.q: Where can I find Dashel Stonefist?
faq.answer: You can find Dashel Stonefist outside in Old Town, among its back alleys near the city's rogue and warrior haunts.

faq.q: Why do investigators need to fight him?
faq.answer: Leads in the search for the missing royal diplomat point investigators to Dashel Stonefist as a collaborator. He is fiercely loyal to his shady employers and will not reveal what he knows until beaten in a bare-knuckle brawl.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist works inside Stormwind as an operative and messenger for the Defias Brotherhood. He coordinates local contacts and street muscle to conceal the Brotherhood's plans from the City Guard.

faq.q: Who is the missing diplomat connected to Dashel?
faq.answer: Royal agents pursue the story of an unnamed diplomat who vanished en route to Theramore.

faq.q: Is Dashel related to any other known dwarves?
faq.answer: No relatives of Dashel Stonefist are recorded. His criminal ties in Stormwind set him apart from reputable dwarven society.

angles.text: For rogues moving through Old Town's criminal web, Dashel Stonefist shows how an operative can talk too much once his jaw is rattled. Trusting brute muscle with delicate secrets is a poor wager.
Many Ironforge dwarves in Stormwind work as honored smiths, mountaineers, or emissaries. Stonefist shows that a dwarf can also fall into street-corner thuggery and treason.
Dashel Stonefist reveals the quiet rot inside Stormwind's capital. The Defias Brotherhood's reach stretches past Westfall's farms and into the sovereign city.
